# Company Overview

**Daiichi Sankyo** 是一家总部位于日本的全球制药公司，业务覆盖oncology、cardiovascular disease、specialty medicine等领域。

在肿瘤领域，Daiichi Sankyo以DXd ADC平台最具代表性。该平台包括HER2-directed ADC trastuzumab deruxtecan以及TROP2-directed ADC **[Datopotamab deruxtecan, Dato-DXd](../compound/Dato_DXd.qmd)**。Dato-DXd由Daiichi Sankyo与[AstraZeneca](AstraZeneca.qmd)共同开发和商业化。

# Selected Products and Programs

| Product or program | Generic name | Area |
|---|---|---|
| Enhertu | Trastuzumab deruxtecan | Oncology / HER2 ADC |
